raw.description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

The role

A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.

What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.

You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.

You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.

What you'll do

  • Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.
  • Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.
  • Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.
  • Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.
  • Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.
  • Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)
  • Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.
  • Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.
  • You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in
  • Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page
  • Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof
  • Experience briefing editors or creators
  • Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about

We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.
  • Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries
  • You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results
  • You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast
  • Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Preference will be given to candidates in Toronto/GTA. They will be hybrid (2 days in-office, 3 days WFH for). Outside of Toronto candidates will be fully remote

Projectleider Installatietechniek Realisatie


Bouw jij mee aan grootschalige projecten in de installatietechniek?

Als Projectleider Installatietechniek Realisatie bij A. de Jong Groep ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van grote en complexe installatietechnische projecten. Denk hierbij aan utiliteitsgebouwen, ziekenhuizen, kantoren en andere omvangrijke projecten waar wij complete werktuigbouwkundige installaties realiseren.

Jij zorgt ervoor dat techniek, planning en budget naadloos samenkomen, waarbij je een scherp oog hebt voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en klanttevredenheid.

Over A. de Jong Groep

A. de Jong Groep is al meer dan 147 jaar een toonaangevende speler in de installatietechniek. Wij realiseren innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen binnen de utiliteitsbouw en industrie. Onze expertise op het gebied van installatietechniek, energieoplossingen en klimaatbeheersing maakt ons een betrouwbare partner voor de grootste projecten in Nederland.

Wat ga je doen?

✔ Verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van grote projecten, van voorbereiding tot oplevering.
✔ Coördineren van het projectteam, bestaande uit werkvoorbereiders, engineers en uitvoerders.
✔ Bewaken van de planning, kosten en kwaliteit, en tijdig bijsturen waar nodig.
✔ Aansturen van leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne teams om projecten succesvol te realiseren.
✔ Overleg met opdrachtgevers, adviseurs en andere stakeholders om verwachtingen te managen en optimale resultaten te behalen.
✔ Signaleren van kansen en risico’s, en hier proactief op inspelen.
✔ Toezien op naleving van wet- en regelgeving, waaronder ARBO en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

Requirements

Wie zoeken wij?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, HBO werk- en denkniveau (MIT, HIT, Werktuigbouwkunde of Technische Bedrijfskunde);

  • Ruime ervaring als projectleider binnen de installatietechniek, bij voorkeur met grote projecten.

  • Sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden, je behoudt het overzicht en weet mensen te motiveren.

  • Kennis van contractvormen zoals UAV en UAV-GC is een pre.

  • Ervaring met software zoals AutoCAD, Revit en projectmanagementtools is een plus.

  • Commercieel en technisch inzicht, je weet hoe je projecten rendabel houdt zonder concessies te doen aan kwaliteit.

  • Een echte leider die het team meeneemt in de projectuitvoering.

  • Salaris: Marktconform, gebaseerd op leeftijd en ervaring.

  • Verlofdagen: 38 dagen, waarvan 13 ADV. Optie tot bij- of verkopen van verlofdagen.

  • Bedrijfswagen,IPhone en Laptop: Voor werk gerelateerde zaken, maar ook privé te gebruiken.

  • Bonusregeling: Afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten.

  • A. de Jong Foundation: A. de Jong Foundation ondersteunt maatschappelijke initiatieven op het gebied van welzijn, educatie, cultuur, sport en milieu, waarbij medewerkers actief bijdragen als vrijwilligers.

  • Fietsplan: Tegen gunstige voorwaarden rijd je op een top fiets voor een goede privé/werk balans.

  • Procedure: Max twee gesprekken een assessment… en door!

  • Ontwikkeling: Je carrière blijft groeien via de A de Jong Academy en onze specialistische partners.

  • Pensioenregeling: Waarvan de werkgever meer dan de helft betaalt.

  • Bedrijfscultuur: Heel veel informele activiteiten en een hechte, betrokken bedrijfscultuur binnen ons familiebedrijf.

Solliciteer vandaag nog en word onderdeel van ons team bij A. de Jong!

We kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten.

Cloud Systems Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Systems Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end cloud solutions covering compute, networking, storage, identity, data, and observability layers.
  • Lead solution architecture reviews and approval processes for major cloud initiatives.
  • Define cloud landing zone, account structure, and tagging strategies for new and existing workloads.
  • Establish reference architectures, blueprints, and reusable patterns adopted across engineering teams.
  • Architect security, identity, and compliance controls embedded into the cloud foundation.
  • Design networking topologies including VPC/VNet design, transit hubs, hybrid connectivity, and private endpoints.
  • Lead cloud migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives across application portfolios.
  • Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices across the cloud estate, partnering with finance and engineering teams to make cloud spend transparent, predictable, and tied to delivered business value.
  • Partner with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls from the outset.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.
  • Track emerging cloud capabilities and ecosystem developments, assessing relevance to current and planned workloads, and recommend strategic adoption based on demonstrated value and operational maturity.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and regulatory obligations, ensuring that cloud designs satisfy both engineering goals and the broader compliance posture of the organization.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.
  • Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.
  • Track record of leading architecture reviews and influencing engineering direction.
  • Cloud architecture certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Multiple cloud architecture certifications.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict cloud compliance requirements.
  • Experience driving FinOps and cost transparency initiatives.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas and expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As an AI Integration & Operations Transformation Specialist, you will play a critical role in embedding AI into day-to-day workflows across multiple business functions. You will bridge the gap between AI capabilities and real-world execution, identifying opportunities, implementing solutions, and enabling teams to adopt AI-driven workflows at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong systems thinking with hands-on execution, and is comfortable operating across functions to drive meaningful operational transformation in a fast-growing environment.

Accountability

Your success as an AI Integration & Operations Transformation Specialist will be defined by the adoption, effectiveness, and scalability of AI-powered workflows across the organization, improving efficiency, speed, and decision-making.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Discovery & AI Strategy

  • Audit workflows across departments to identify high-impact opportunities for AI integration.
  • Develop and prioritize a company-wide roadmap for AI adoption.
  • Stay current on emerging AI tools, models, and capabilities.

Solution Design & Implementation

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows tailored to team-specific needs.
  • Integrate AI tools into existing systems, including spreadsheets, operational tools, and internal platforms.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and usable in real-world contexts.

Enablement & Training

  • Lead hands-on training sessions to support cross-functional AI adoption.
  • Develop playbooks, frameworks, and documentation to enable repeatable usage.
  • Act as a go-to resource for troubleshooting and guidance on AI tools.
  • Drive sustained adoption and usage across teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Optimization

  • Partner with teams across operations, marketing, finance, and design to align solutions with business needs.
  • Adapt workflows based on team requirements, skill levels, and priorities.
  • Measure impact and continuously iterate on implemented solutions.

Colleagues

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams and leadership, acting as a key partner in driving AI adoption and operational transformation across the organization.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As an AI Integration & Operations Transformation Specialist, your vertical focus will be on designing and implementing AI-powered workflows, while your horizontal focus will include cross-functional operations, process optimization, and change enablement.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in operations, consulting, product, or similar roles, with demonstrated experience implementing AI or automation solutions in business environments.
  • AI & Automation Expertise: Strong understanding of AI tools, LLMs, and workflow automation platforms, with hands-on experience applying them to real-world use cases.
  • Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable, practical solutions.
  • Implementation & Execution: Experience translating abstract concepts into operational systems, with a strong bias toward action and delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work across multiple teams, adapting solutions to different workflows, skill levels, and business needs.
  • Communication & Enablement: Strong ability to explain technical concepts clearly and train non-technical stakeholders to adopt new tools and workflows.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • AI Workflow Design & Implementation: How you translate AI capabilities into practical, scalable business solutions.
  • Systems Thinking & Problem-Solving: How you identify inefficiencies and design effective operational improvements.
  • Adoption & Change Enablement: How you drive usage and ensure long-term success of implemented solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: How you work across teams to align solutions with diverse needs.
  • Execution & Ownership: How you move from idea to implementation in fast-moving environments.
  • Communication & Training: How you simplify complex concepts and enable teams to confidently adopt new tools.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 90 days with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans, we build remote teams that connect the world’s top 1% of talent with visionary leaders. With us, you’re not just doing a job - you’re redefining your career with opportunities designed to unlock your potential. We welcome the chance to discuss the complementary parts of our business during your interview process and encourage questions about where we are and where we are going.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

raw.description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

About the role

This role is the analytical and operational link between AssetWatch’s business stakeholders and the Revenue Systems delivery team. The right person brings genuine business analysis instincts — the ability to surface requirements, resolve competing priorities, and translate complex business needs into something a development team can execute — alongside the organizational discipline to keep a fast-moving sprint cadence on track.

What's the opportunity

Requirements Gathering and Business Analysis

You will lead structured discovery sessions with stakeholders across Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Customer Success Operations, Engineering, and Product — not just attending them but facilitating them. That means surfacing unstated assumptions, identifying conflicting requirements before they reach development, and documenting what was agreed to with enough precision that the team can build from it without circling back. You will translate those conversations into well-formed user stories with clear acceptance criteria, evaluate solution options against real business constraints, and flag trade-offs before work begins.

Stakeholder Alignment and Conflict Resolution

Multiple teams will often bring competing priorities and different interpretations of what a system should do. You will own the alignment work — getting the right people in the room, making trade-offs visible, and resolving conflicts before they become delivery delays. That includes keeping sprint commitments transparent to dependent teams and managing expectations proactively when scope or timelines need to shift. This role operates across many teams and inbound requests simultaneously — strong organizational habits and the ability to carry multiple priorities forward at once without losing momentum on any of them are part of what makes someone successful here.

Process Improvement and UAT

You will document current-state business processes, identify opportunities for automation and workflow improvement, and own the full UAT lifecycle for every enhancement before it reaches production. That means writing test scripts, coordinating business reviewers, triaging defects, and confirming sign-off before any deployment goes live.

Sprint Operations and User Support

You will manage the Jira backlog, run sprint planning and daily standups, follow up before sprint deadlines, and send action items and release notes after each deployment. You will also triage inbound Salesforce support requests through the team’s Slack channel, acknowledge requests promptly, route issues appropriately, and keep stakeholders informed throughout.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in a BSA, Revenue Operations, or Salesforce-adjacent role in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating requirements sessions and writing user stories with acceptance criteria
  • Comfortable navigating competing stakeholder priorities and resolving cross-team conflicts
  • Strong written communication with an instinct for documenting decisions and process
  • Proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously and maintain pace across all of them
  • Agile sprint management experience with Jira
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ/NUE, NetSuite, or Boomi is a plus

The base salary range for this full-time position is posted below, plus equity and benefits. Variable pay, bonuses, and other cash compensation will be discussed throughout the interview process.

The salary range was determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range applicable to your location during the hiring process.

$100,000—$119,580 USD

AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.
  • Competitive compensation package including stock options
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match
  • Opportunity to make a real impact every day
  • Work with a dynamic and growing team
  • Unlimited PTO
We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.

raw.excerpt: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Strategic Supportability Operations (SSO) sits within Risk Operations and User Policy Operations. Our team is focused on protecting and advancing Stripe's business, brand, and mission by deploying industry-leading supportability solutions that instill user and partner trust in Stripe, while enabling progressive and sustainable business growth. Unlike other Risk Operations teams, SSO handles the most complex, high-stakes, and ambiguous user business cases—ones that require deep investigation, custom risk analysis, and creative problem-solving at the intersection of user experience, compliance, financial partner requirements, and Stripe's growth ambitions.

What you’ll do

As a Risk Operations Analyst on the Strategic Supportability Operations team, you will investigate and assess complex, gray-area user business cases that require deep risk judgment and tailored solutions. You will go beyond standard procedures to understand the full risk profile of users, develop custom recommendations, and collaborate across internal teams to drive cohesive, well-reasoned decisions. You will also play a key role in identifying patterns across individual cases to improve our processes, policies, and detection systems at scale—bridging tactical case work with strategic, systemic impact across Risk Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate complex, high-risk, and gray-area user business cases, applying deep risk knowledge to make sound, non-binary judgments
  • Navigate ambiguity confidently—develop custom, evidence-based solutions where standard frameworks do not fully apply
  • Identify and escalate systemic trends across cases, proposing scalable solutions to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Collaborate across Risk Operations, User Support, Risk Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, and Product to develop holistic risk mitigation strategies
  • Engage directly with users—in both positive and sensitive conversations—always maintaining a Users First mindset while balancing regulatory and financial partner requirements
  • Communicate complex risk findings clearly to internal partners, financial partners, and Stripe leadership
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of SSO processes, decision frameworks, and tooling
  • Build and maintain documentation, procedures, and playbooks to support team scalability and knowledge management
  • Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies and recommend enhancements through a collaborative approach with stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, fraud, financial operations, or a closely related field in a fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate gray-area and non-binary decision-making in complex risk environments
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into a coherent risk narrative
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally on complex problems and driving alignment across teams with competing priorities
  • Ability to engage directly with users—including in difficult or sensitive conversations—with empathy, clarity, and professionalism
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex risk findings to varied audiences
  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced, constantly evolving environments
  • Track record of identifying systemic problems from individual case patterns and driving process improvements
  • Deep empathy for entrepreneurs and businesses, and genuine motivation to solve problems that empower them
  • The ability and desire to challenge the status quo as a creative thinker who considers problems from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented

Preferred requirements

  • Familiarity with compliance or financial partnership relationship management
  • Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies in a fintech or payments environment
  • Working knowledge of data analysis and AI tools to quantify risk & inform decisions
  • Background in regulatory compliance within financial services
  • Experience developing scalable operational frameworks or playbooks in an ambiguous, high-stakes environment
  • Knowledge of payment processing systems and associated risks

raw.description:
💻 Kodland Hakkında

Kodland, 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara kodlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur.

  • 50.000+ aktif öğrenci — Türkiye'de 5.500+

  • 3.000+ takım arkadaşı — Türkiye ekibinde 300+

  • 9 farklı pazar: Türkiye, Doğu Avrupa, BDT Ülkeleri, Latin Amerika, Brezilya, Endonezya, Körfez Ülkeleri, UK/US

Türkiye ekibimize katılacak, mevcut ve geçmiş Kodland ailelerine telefon ve WhatsApp üzerinden ulaşacak İç Satış Yöneticileri (ISM) arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyon bir ders anlatma rolü değildir. Danışmanlık yaklaşımıyla yürütülen, portföy yönetimi ve sonuç odaklı satışın birleştiği tam zamanlı bir satış rolüdür.

🎯 Bu rolde ne yapacaksın?

Sana atanan aile portföyünü telefon, WhatsApp ve diğer kanallar üzerinden yöneteceksin.

Gün boyunca:

  • Kodland'da halihazırda ders almış ya da almakta olan ailelerle iletişim kuracak,

  • Çocuğun mevcut ilerlemesini ve ailenin beklentilerini anlayacak,

  • Kurs yenileme, paket yükseltme ve ek kurs satışlarını yöneteceksin,

  • Velilerin sorularını yanıtlayacak, itirazları profesyonel şekilde karşılayacaksın,

  • Fiyatlandırmayı netleştirecek, ödeme adımını ve tahsilat takibini sonuçlandıracaksın,

  • Portföyündeki her ailenin durumunu ve bir sonraki adımını CRM üzerinde güncel tutacak,

  • Her temastan sonra sisteme not bırakacaksın,

  • Aylık ciro ve dönüşüm hedeflerini takip edeceksin.

Kendi müşterini bulman beklenmez. Lead'ler sistem üzerinden ekibe düzenli olarak dağıtılır. Konuşma metinleri, itiraz karşılama rehberleri, fiyat hesaplayıcı ve ekip desteği sağlanır.

Senden beklenen; görüşmeyi aktif şekilde yönetmen, ailenin ihtiyacını doğru okuman, Kodland programlarının değerini net şekilde göstermen ve satış fırsatlarını sonuca ulaştırmandır.

Günlük hedefler: ortalama 50 arama ve 90 dakika aktif konuşma süresi. Tüm satış süreci tek bir panelden yönetilir; düzenli ve şeffaftır.

🕒 Çalışma Modeli — Gününü Sen Planlarsın

  • Tamamen uzaktan, freelance çalışma modeli — nerede olursan ol

  • Haftada 5 gün, günde 8 saat (1 saatlik molan dahil), haftada 2 gün tatil

  • Esnek başlangıç: güne 11.00–13.00 arasında dilediğin saatte başlarsın

  • Yoğun saatler: 18.00–21.00 — velilere en kolay bu saatlerde ulaşılır

  • Mola sende: 1 saatlik molanı gün içinde istediğin zaman kullanırsın

  • Erken bitirme hakkı: günlük KPI hedeflerini tamamladığında mesaini erken bitirebilirsin

💰 Kazanç Modeli

Kazancın iki parçadan oluşur:

  • 14.000 ₺ sabit maaş — performansından bağımsız, her ay garanti

  • Satış primi — belirli bir aylık satış tutarını geçtiğinde devreye girer ve satışın büyüdükçe oranı da artar

Buna ek olarak yüksek satış tutarlarında ek bonuslar ve her ay ilk 3 ISM'e verilen ödüller var.

Peki bu pratikte ne demek?

Ekibimizdeki ISM'ler genellikle aylık 25.000 – 50.000 ₺ kazanıyor. Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış yapanlar 80.000 ₺ ve üzerine ulaşabiliyor.

Prim oranlarını ve eşikleri, ekibimizin gerçek verileriyle birlikte mülakat aşamasında adım adım anlatıyoruz.

Belirtilen tutarlar garanti gelir değil, mevcut ekip performansına dayalı gerçek kazanç aralıklarıdır.

🧭 Eğitim ve İşe Alım Süreci

Başarılı adaylar gerçek ailelerle çalışmaya başlamadan önce yapılandırılmış bir eğitim ve değerlendirme sürecinden geçer:

  1. Başvurunun değerlendirilmesi

  2. Kısa ön değerlendirme görüşmesi

  3. Eğitim grubuna katılım — şirket, ürün, sistemler, satış temelleri ve itiraz karşılama üzerine teorik eğitim (yaklaşık 3–5 iş günü)

  4. Final değerlendirme — arama simülasyonu / rol-play ve kısa bilgi testi

  5. Canlı lead'lerle pratik dönem (ekip lideri geri bildirimi eşliğinde)

  6. Sözleşme, sistem erişimleri ve deneme süresi

🚀 Kodland Sana Ne Sunuyor?

  • Tamamen uzaktan çalışma ve esnek başlangıç saati

  • Garantili sabit maaş + performansa bağlı satış primi ve bonuslar

  • Hazır satış materyalleri: konuşma metinleri, itiraz karşılama rehberleri, fiyat hesaplayıcı

  • Tek panelden yönetilen, şeffaf bir CRM düzeni

  • Kapsamlı eğitim ve adaptasyon süreci

  • Team Leader, Head ve kalite ekibinden düzenli geri bildirim

  • 9 pazarda faaliyet gösteren uluslararası bir EdTech şirketinde deneyim

  • Satış, müzakere ve müşteri ilişkileri alanında gelişim fırsatı

  • Çocukların gelecekte kullanacağı beceriler kazanmasına katkı sağlayan anlamlı bir ürün

Requirements

✅ Zorunlu Gereksinimler

  • Türkiye'de ikamet

  • En az 6 ay satış deneyimi — telefonla satış, iç satış, retention, upsell, account management veya satış bileşeni olan müşteri hizmetleri

  • Türkçeyi akıcı, net ve güven veren şekilde kullanabilme; anlaşılır diksiyon

  • Telefon ve video görüşmelerinde kendinden emin sözlü iletişim

  • İtiraz karşılama ve fiyat görüşmesi konusunda rahat olma

  • CRM veya benzeri bir portföy/takip sistemi kullanma deneyimi

  • Yüzde, oran ve basit hesaplamalarla rahat çalışabilme

  • Günde ortalama 50 arama ve 90 dakika aktif konuşma temposuyla çalışmaya açık olma

  • Hedef ve KPI odaklı çalışabilme; reddedilmeye karşı dayanıklılık

  • Haftada 5 gün, günde 8 saat düzenli uygunluk; 18.00–21.00 yoğun saat aralığında aktif olabilme

  • Freelance çalışma modelinin sana uygun olması

  • Bu rolü ana çalışma düzeni olarak sürdürebilme

  • Uzaktan çalışma düzeninde zamanını disiplinli şekilde yönetebilme

Teknik gereksinimler:

  • En az 8 GB RAM'e sahip, güvenilir bir bilgisayar

  • Kaliteli mikrofon (tercihen kulaklık) ve çalışır durumda kamera

  • Stabil ve hızlı internet bağlantısı

  • Sessiz ve profesyonel bir çalışma ortamı

🌟 Avantaj Sağlayacak Deneyimler

  • EdTech, SaaS, telekomünikasyon, sigorta, turizm/konaklama veya B2C danışmanlı satış

  • Çağrı merkezi veya telesatış

  • Retention, yenileme ya da upsell odaklı roller

  • HubSpot, Salesforce, Bitrix24, amoCRM gibi CRM sistemleri

  • Eğitim sektörü ya da velilerle birebir iletişim deneyimi

  • İngilizce (global ekip iletişimi ve dokümantasyon için)

Bu deneyimlere sahip olman zorunlu değildir. Güçlü iletişim becerilerine, satış motivasyonuna ve öğrenme isteğine sahip adaylar da değerlendirilir.

🎯 Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olabilir, Eğer:

  • Telefonda konuşmayı ve insanların ihtiyacını anlamayı seviyorsan,

  • Kazancının performansına bağlı olması seni motive ediyorsa,

  • İtirazların satış sürecinin doğal bir parçası olduğunu biliyorsan,

  • Düzenli takibin sonuç getirdiğinin farkındaysan,

  • Kendi portföyünü düzenli ve güncel tutmaktan keyif alıyorsan,

  • Gününü kendi ritmine göre kurgulayabileceğin bir esnekliği değerli buluyorsan,

  • Geri bildirime ve kalite değerlendirmesine açıksan.

⚠️ Bu Rol Sana Uygun Olmayabilir, Eğer:

  • Günde yüksek sayıda telefon görüşmesi yapmak istemiyorsan,

  • Akşam saatlerinde (18.00–21.00) çalışmak sana uygun değilse,

  • Fiyat konuşmak, satış kapatmak ya da ödeme takibi yapmak seni rahatsız ediyorsa,

  • Kazancının büyük kısmının performansa bağlı olduğu bir modeli tercih etmiyorsan,

  • Freelance çalışma modeli yerine bordrolu bir düzen arıyorsan,

  • Bu işi ikinci iş veya yan gelir olarak düşünüyorsan.

raw.description:
Company Description


Alliant University is a professional practice University committed to excellence in four areas: Education for Professional Practice, Scholarship, Multicultural and International Competence and Community Engagement. The University provides students with the highest quality of education through excellence and innovation in academic scholarship, applied training and research, and community service, particularly to underserved populations. Through its Mission, the University's goal is to equip students with the competencies they need to provide public benefit and make an impact in their communities by addressing major contemporary social issues. Core competencies of the University's training programs include cultural diversity, which is infused in courses and field placements and is manifest in the diversity of its students, faculty.

Our Mission:
Alliant University prepares students for professional careers of service and leadership, and promotes the discovery and application of knowledge to improve the lives of people in diverse cultures and communities around the world.

Our Vision:
An inclusive world empowered by Alliant alumni.

Our IMPACT Values:

  • Inclusion: We value and engage the rich diversity of the Alliant community.
  • Mentoring: We provide guidance and create enabling environments for success.
  • Passion: We bring enthusiasm, creativity, and authenticity to our work.
  • Accountability: We act with integrity and responsibility in all we do.
  • Communication: We are responsive, transparent, and respectful in our interactions.
  • Teamwork: We collaborate to develop innovative solutions for our community.

Job Description


The School of Education at Alliant University offers a variety of degrees, certificates, and credentials in education that prepare students to make a lasting impact through teaching, counseling, leadership, advocacy, administration, management, and community work. Whether a student looking for an online degree program or an in-person learning experience, Alliant will be there to guide them every step of the way. The student’s path into the classroom — either online or on-ground — is one paved with comprehensive academic excellence through:

  • California Commission on Teacher Credentialing (CTC) certification of many of our world-class education programs,
  • Multiple degree options, including credentials and CSOE certifications, undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral degrees, many of which offer specialized emphases.
  • Hands-on training facilitated by extensive practicum opportunities.
  • Multiculturalism interwoven throughout the curriculum and rooted in our university culture; offering an educational experience rich with diversity and inclusion,

Our specialty is helping students transform experience into expertise, and expertise into leadership. Every one of our California Education Degree Programs is designed to ensure that the real-world needs of learners and the latest research central to the curriculum in our online, hybrid, and on-campus courses. We currently offer the following degree programs:

  • Single-Subject Teachers
  • Multiple-Subject Teachers
  • Special Education Teachers
  • School Psychologists
  • School Counselors
  • Educational Leaders and Managers
  • California Teachers of English Learners (CTEL) and Cross-Cultural Language and Academic Development (CLAD) Certification
  • We also offer Certificates in Elementary and Secondary school teaching as issued in the State of Arizona.

You can learn more about CSOE by visiting the Alliant web site at . If you are interested in joining our team of experts or have other questions about our program, please contact us at .

Application Description:
Applicants to this position will be considered for a candidate pool encompassing one or more of the subject areas outlined in the job description. This pool will be used to identify qualified candidates for potential appointments during the 2026–2027 academic year.

Salary Range: $31 - $36 hourly (based on course requirements & level of education). This is a temporary, non-benefits eligible role.

Program Description:

Adjunct Faculty for the Pupil Personnel Services School Psychology Program, under the direction of the Program Director of PPS School Psychology, provides instruction, guidance, and support to SOE candidates (students) online via Canvas.

This program prepares students to gain the Pupil Personnel Services (PPS) credential that allows them to practice in California’s schools. The program will be of interest to recent college graduates with bachelor’s degrees, current educators, school personnel and professionals from other related fields.


Qualifications


Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

  • Master’s, Doctoral or other terminal degree from an accredited college or university, depending upon the needs of the course being taught.

Experience:

  • Appropriate experience in the areas(s) of specialization and expertise. At least three (3) years of experience as a School Psychologist. Educational Psychologist through the BBS (LEP), is preferred.

Additional Information


Duties & Responsibilities: (Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions).

  • Facilitating Classroom and Distance/Distributed Learning
  • Course and syllabus implementation/facilitation
  • Assessment and evaluation of candidates
  • Video-guided instruction
  • Mentoring and advising of candidates
  • Holding virtual office hours and conferencing with candidates
  • Research/scholarship mentoring and supervision, particularly of MA theses, PsyD projects, EdD dissertations

Skills:

  • Proficient computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office programs.
  • The ability to work independently and be self-motivated.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail and the ability to problem solve.
  • The ability to explain complex requirements in clear and concise terms.
  • The ability to be flexible with workflow to meet the needs of the department and candidates and to manage multiple tasks per required deadlines.
  • The drive to encourage, direct, hold accountable and guide candidates toward task completion.
  • Must demonstrate the ability to work as an effective team member and develop trusting relationships with candidates and Alliant employees, as well as the Registrar’s Office and various academic departments.
  • Culturally competent and ability to communicate and interact effectively with diverse people.
  • Highly motivated, focused and results oriented.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and tact in all interpersonal interactions, and to maintain confidentiality.
  • Collaboration and partnering with other university stakeholders to support candidate success. Ability to make administrative/procedural decisions and judgments.

Supervisory Responsibility:

Direct Reports: Program Director, School Psychology.

Indirect Reports: None.

Contact Responsibility:

Internal: Interacts with Program Director to receive support and guidance throughout the instructional term. Main communication is between Adjunct Faculty and currently enrolled candidates.

External: None.

Work Environment:

This is a fully remote position, with faculty choosing their own environment to teach in.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to execute those physical activities required to perform the essential functions including, but not limited to, regular sitting and being mobile; continual communicating; regular keyboarding; regular reading of both print and digital material; and all other activities required to perform essential functions.

Compliance:

Responsible to perform all work in a manner that complies with the organization policies, applicable regulations, applicable standards of professional performance, or other recognized laws or requirements as these policies, regulations, standards, laws or requirements relate to the position.

Hybrid & remote opportunities available

Mint Velvet began when founders Liz Houghton and Lisa Agar-Rea set out to create an unfailingly chic collection of contemporary, great quality staples and elevated fits that they felt were missing from their wardrobes. Feeling frustrated that they couldn’t find anything they wanted to wear, or the great customer service they craved, they started fusing relaxed comfort with glamorous yet wearable fashion trends. Relaxed Glamour was born.
As collaborative creatives, we take untold pride in our work, designing with heart and soul. We want to be a force for good and are committed to becoming a more circular and responsible business, from the fabrics we choose to our considered processes. We are an agile and growing business, and we work hard to create an environment which allows for growth and progression, balanced with the support and flexibility needed to meet the challenge of a high-performance culture.
Our leadership teams and founders sit amongst the teams and encourage a culture of balance and passion. MV is a very special place, and our values are anchored by three main pillars: people, planet, and community.

Our Values:
With Soul. Courage & Resilience. Passion & Drive. Entrepreneurial Spirit. Collaborative.

The Role

Our Customer Care Advisors play a key role in delivering our customer care objectives and ensuring the brand surpasses customer expectations. This is a fast-paced, varied role where you will communicate with customers across all channels including telephone, email, live chat & social media, to provide a unique and personal service.

The Role:
  • Ensuring that a bespoke and personal service is provided to every customer to meet their needs
  • Responding to customer queries within our agreed response time
  • Handling customer queries across different platforms, including live chat, phone calls, email and social media
  • Building relationships with customers and using initiative when dealing with queries
  • Liaising with the warehouse team and couriers to resolve any order issues
  • Working closely with stores and other head office departments
Please note: to accommodate our international customers, you will be required to work until 8pm on one or two evenings per week. Working hours will also include some Saturday and bank holiday cover.

We are open to both remote and hybrid working.

What You'll Have

  • 1 year’s proven experience working in a similar role (including live chat, phone calls and email), either office-based or remote
  • You'll possess a genuine passion for customer care
  • A confident and comfortable telephone manner, with the ability to demonstrate excellent communication skills (written & verbal)
  • You are confident working in a fast-paced, multi-channel environment and able to demonstrate initiative
  • Brilliant organisation and multi-tasking skills, whilst retaining a high attention to detail
  • You consistently role model our Mint Velvet brand values

You'll Be Rewarded With

  • Competitive starting salary and great career prospects in a fast paced and growing business
  • 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays and a day off on your birthday
  • Company-funded private health insurance and access to Smart Health
  • Life assurance
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • 50% staff discount
  • Bespoke induction support and ongoing development to help you thrive in your new role

raw.description:
About Guideway Care*

Guideway Care is The Patient Activation Company™. We don't just "engage" patients; we activate them. By utilizing our proprietary Motivational Patient Guidance (MPG) model and AI-powered technology, we resolve the practical and psychological barriers that prevent patients from taking their "next right action."™

Job Summary:

The Clinical Service Lead (CSL) is a non-exempt, front-line operational leadership role responsible for the day-to-day execution of Guideway Care clinical service. This role is designed as a working operational lead accountable for service delivery, workflow stability, and partner-facing operational coordination. The CSL does not function as a people manager and does not hold formal performance management or disciplinary authority.

The Clinical Service Lead plays a critical role in ensuring high-quality, efficient, and compliant clinical service delivery across assigned operational lanes. The role focuses on managing work rather than managing employees, serving as a key execution partner to leadership while remainingclosely connected to frontline workflows.

Essential Functions:

  • Own day-to-day execution of assigned clinical service workflows, ensuring service-level agreements, quality standards, and operational deliverables are met
  • Manage and stabilize clinical workflows, case assignments, and outreach activities to support timely, high-quality care delivery
  • Serve as an operational point of contact for external partners, including providing service updates, coordinating deliverables, and supporting implementation readiness
  • Prepare and deliver routine operational reports related to service performance, workflow status, and partner commitments
  • Spend a defined portion of time (approximately 20–50%) performing clinical or operational production work to support coverage, backlog management, and high-priority needs
  • Support onboarding and workflow training for clinical staff, reinforcing protocols, documentation standards, and system use
  • Monitor operational trends related to quality, productivity, and attendance and escalate risks or concerns to leadership
  • Approve staff timecards and support scheduling coordination as an administrative function
  • Identify operational improvement opportunities and support adoption of tools, processes, and technology enhancements
  • Maintain required partner documentation and ensure compliance with clinical protocols, PHI, and regulatory standards
  • Support change management, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of a requested change in service
  • Any other duties necessary to drive our values, fulfill our mission, and abide by our company values.

Service Accountability:

The Clinical Service Lead is directly responsible for the day‑to‑day operational service outcomes of assigned clinical workflows or service lanes, including service‑level performance, quality standards, and partner deliverables.

Accountability for personnel decisions, strategic program outcomes, budgetary authority, and employment actions remain with operational manager.

Role Scope and Boundaries:

The Clinical Service Lead is not a formal people manager and does not conduct performance evaluations, issue corrective action, or make employment decisions

All formal performance management, disciplinary action, and employee development planning are owned by exempt leadership

The CSL provides operational observations and performance trend insights for escalation purposes only

The CSL focuses on ownership of service delivery and workflow outcomes rather than individual employee performance management

Partner Engagement:

Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book that equips husbands to love and lead their wives in the example of Christ, while addressing real-life issues that arise in marriage. This project should combine theological depth that is accessible, personal stories, and practical application to help husbands grow in faithful love and leadership.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

About Sapio Sciences

Sapio Sciences is on a mission to accelerate scientific drug discovery and high-throughput clinical and diagnostics for our clients and partners. The Sapio team consists of expert and highly collaborative scientists, software developers, and professionals passionate about providing a best-in-class lab informatics platform and industry-specific solutions.
Sapio is one of the few software providers to offer a truly unified and highly configurable lab informatics platform and a broad suite of purpose-built solutions. The Sapio platform makes it easy for scientists, laboratory, and bio/informatics professionals to streamline and manage their end-to-end laboratory operations, from instrument data integration to workflow and experiment setup to sample and materials management, data management, and scientific data analysis and reporting.

Working at Sapio

At Sapio, we’re not just building lab informatics solutions. We’re creating tools made for the scientist and motivated to make the world a better place. We understand that lab informatics is about more than managing data or connecting workflows. It’s about making life easier for the scientist and making scientific progress faster for everyone. Our platform delivers the levels of configurability, usability and insight that scientists have only ever dreamed of.
We’re a team of scientists, developers and innovators who question convention and stay focused on what matters most - advancing drug discovery science. We challenge the status quo and respond to the needs at the heart of science with powerful solutions that are simple to use, effortless to evolve and downright easy to love.
As part of the Sapio team, you’ll work in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where your ideas are valued, your growth matters and your work makes a difference.
We’re proud to partner with leading labs around the world, from ambitious start-ups to global organisations, who trust Sapio to support discovery, development and diagnostics with industry-first science-aware solutions.
Position Summary
Sapio Sciences is looking for a strategic, hands-on talent leader to own the end-to-end hiring process for the company and its dual-brand structure across Sapio and Sigmatic Sciences. As we scale, the Director, Talent Acquisition will be responsible for attracting, engaging, and hiring exceptional talent, ensuring every leader has the right people in the right seats to grow their teams with confidence. This role blends strategy with execution: building a scalable, brand-forward recruiting function while personally driving searches for critical and senior roles. This individual will serve as a trusted partner to the executive team and hiring managers, anticipating workforce needs, elevating the candidate experience, and ensuring Sapio is known as a destination for top talent in life sciences software. Living the Sapio brand and building genuine, lasting relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders will guide all activities.
Work Location
Remote (with a strong preference for candidates based in the US Eastern Time Zone / East Coast)

Responsibilities

    Talent Acquisition Strategy & Ownership
    • Own the full-cycle recruiting process end to end, from workforce planning and intake through sourcing, assessment, offer, and close, across all functions and geographies.
    • Partner with the CPO and executive leadership to translate hiring plans and headcount forecasts into actionable recruiting strategies that keep pace with growth.
    • Build and continuously improve a scalable talent acquisition function, including process, playbooks, and infrastructure that support efficient, high-quality hiring at scale.
    • Establish and track recruiting KPIs, time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, pipeline health, offer acceptance, and source effectiveness, and report accurately to leadership and the board as needed.
    End-to-End Recruiting Execution
    • Personally lead and run searches for business-critical roles, going beyond basic coordination and acting as a true search partner.
    • Develop proactive sourcing strategies to build diverse, high-caliber pipelines, including passive candidate outreach and market mapping.
    • Manage a consistent, efficient interview and selection process that moves quickly without compromising on quality or fit.
    • Ensure timely, thoughtful communication with candidates at every stage, protecting speed and experience simultaneously.
    Leadership & Hiring Manager Partnership
    • Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and the executive team, guiding them on market realities, role design, leveling, and compensation in partnership with the People team.
    • Coach and enable managers to run effective, structured interviews and make sound, timely hiring decisions.
    • Anticipate the needs of teams as they grow and expand, staying ahead of demand rather than reacting to it.
    • Align closely with the broader People function surrounding the onboarding hand-off, ensuring a seamless candidate-to-employee transition.
    Employer Brand & Candidate Experience
    • Champion Sapio’s employer brand in the market, positioning the company as an employer of choice within life sciences and scientific software.
    • Design a candidate experience that reflects the Sapio brand, personable, respectful, and high touch at every interaction.
    • Strive for a hiring experience that leaves every candidate, hired or not, as an advocate for Sapio.
    Process, Systems & Efficiency
    • Own, administer, and optimize Lever (ATS) as the system of record for all recruiting activity ensuring data integrity, clean pipeline hygiene, and accurate, real-time reporting.
    • Continuously improve the recruiting process end to end, identifying bottlenecks and designing workflows, automation, and playbooks that drive speed and efficiency without sacrificing quality.
    • Configure and evolve Lever to support the team as it scales building pipelines, stages, templates, and integrations that streamline the hiring workflow.
    • Use data and market insight to measure process performance, inform strategy, and drive continuous improvement in time-to-fill, cost, and quality of hire.
    • Ensure compliance with employment regulations and consistent, equitable hiring practices across all regions in which Sapio operates.

Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 8+ years of full-cycle talent acquisition experience in a high-growth environment, including personally managing senior and Director-level searches.
    • Prior experience building or scaling a talent acquisition function, ideally within SaaS, or life sciences.
    • Hands-on experience administering and optimizing an ATS (Lever strongly preferred).
    • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies (US and international, UK/Europe, a plus).
    • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and supporting board- or PE-facing hiring priorities preferred.

Required Skills & Abilities

    • Strategic and hands-on: able to design the strategy and personally execute the searches that matter most.
    • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills with candidates, hiring managers, and executive leaders.
    • Excellent organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume, high complexity req load.
    • Data-driven mindset with deep proficiency in Lever or comparable ATS platforms and recruiting analytics.
    • A process-improvement orientation — always looking to make the hiring engine faster, cleaner, and more efficient.
    • Sound judgment on talent, leveling, and compensation.
    • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with a genuine commitment to a great candidate and hiring-manager experience.

Our People

At Sapio Sciences, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our lab informatics solutions are powered not just by technology, but by a shared commitment to our core values—what we proudly call The Sapio Seven, aka EMBRACE:
- Embrace the future
- Make a difference
- Be true partners
- Remember why we’re here
- Act with empathy
- Commit to transparency
- Excel in quality
These values shape how we work, how we grow, and how we deliver impact for our clients every day.

Reasonable Adjustments

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Functieomschrijving
Ben jij een gemotiveerde regiebehandelaar met een passie voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg? Wil je werken in een dynamisch team dat zich inzet om de zorg in Nederland te verbeteren? Dan is Beterggz op zoek naar jou!

Wie zijn wij?
Beterggz is dé innovatieve online specialist in de specialistische GGZ, waar we landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aanbieden. Ons behandelteam, bestaande uit psychologen, artsen en psychiaters, werkt nauw samen om cliënten met een complexe zorgvraag de beste zorg te bieden. Wij geloven in een vernieuwende aanpak gebaseerd op bewezen resultaten en zetten ons in om wachtlijsten te verkorten. Ook al werken we op verschillende locaties of zelfs in verschillende landen, we delen samen één missie: de geestelijke gezondheidszorg verbeteren en de lange wachtlijsten aanpakken!

Wat ga je doen?
Als regiebehandelaar maak je deel uit van het multidisciplinaire team. Je onderzoekt en begeleidt cliënten met psychische en gedragsproblemen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de behandeling van onze patiënten. Je bent een van de regiebehandelaren en voert individuele en/of groepsbehandelingen uit, die voornamelijk bestaan uit cognitieve gedragstherapie en/of EMDR.

  • Je houdt je bezig met intakes en psycho-diagnostisch onderzoek.

  • Je hebt een coachende rol richting je collega’s.

  • Je denkt samen met jouw collega’s na over de ontwikkeling van het behandelbeleid en de kwaliteit van zorg, waarbij jouw inbreng wordt gewaardeerd.

Als je het leuk vindt om uitgedaagd te worden in een innovatieve omgeving en je je wilt inzetten voor het welzijn van cliënten, dan is deze rol iets voor jou!

Requirements

Wie ben jij?
Jij bent een enthousiaste en betrokken regiebehandelaar met de volgende kwalificaties:

  • Je beschikt BIG-registratie en AGB-code.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met een brede generalistische visie binnen de SGGZ.

  • Je bent proactief en hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Je bent flexibel en kunt goed in teamverband werken.

  • Je bent digitaal vaardig en kunt snel werken met nieuwe programma’s.

  • Je registreert nauwkeurig je verrichtingen en bent stipt in je werk.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met een complexere zorgvraag.

Waarom kiezen voor Beterggz?
Je komt terecht in een platte, informele organisatie waar collegialiteit hoog in het vaandel staat. Er is weinig hiërarchie en veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Bij ons werk je niet alleen snel, vriendelijk en effectief, maar ook in een sfeer waar jouw ideeën gewaardeerd worden. We kunnen een arbeidsovereenkomst aanbieden, ook al woon je in het buitenland. Wij werken volledig remote! Dit biedt jou de kans om werk en leven op een flexibele manier te combineren en tegelijkertijd bij te dragen aan de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in Nederland.

Je wordt ingeschaald in schaal 65 of 70 volgens de CAO GGZ.

Je kunt per direct starten.

Uren zijn bespreekbaar.

Klinkt dit als de ideale uitdaging voor jou? Reageer dan snel! Stuur je motivatie en CV naar .

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.

Een VOG-verklaring maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

raw.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

What we can offer you

  • A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

Marketing Coordinator
Position Location: Remote
Reports to: Head of Partnerships

About SkinnyDipped

Located in Seattle, SkinnyDipped was founded by a mom, her daughter, and two best friends after realizing that nothing is more important than time spent with the ones you love. Starting out of their kitchen, the four women created SkinnyDipped: thinly dipped chocolate almonds that are exceptionally good-for-you and ridiculously delicious. We are a women-led company driven by the belief that healthy snacking should make both you and your body happy.

The Opportunity

We’re on the hunt for an enthusiastic, roll-up-your-sleeves Marketing Coordinator to support our lean, mighty, and fast-moving marketing team. This is the ultimate ‘get-your-hands-dirty’ role for someone eager to grow their career in marketing.

You’ll be at the center of the action - supporting events, coordinating major trade shows, sourcing and managing vendors, ordering merch, and everything in between. One day you might be coordinating a demo tour, and the next you’re helping prep for a major partnership or activation. If you’re excited by the idea of learning a little bit of everything, jumping into a high-growth entrepreneurial brand, and working with a passionate team, we want to talk to you!

What You’ll Do

    Be the Right Hand of the Marketing Team

    • Plan, coordinate, and execute trade shows - including budgeting, booth logistics, timeline management, and on-site support from setup to takedown.
    • Manage the logistics and scheduling for retailer demos and sampling events across the country.
    • Support brand activations, influencer events, and partnerships - coordinating timelines, sourcing furniture, branded materials etc.. working with vendors and ensuring seamless on-site execution.
    • Manage and train a team of Brand Ambassadors on an as-needed basis
    • Coordinating influencer mailers including everything from managing vendors and working with operations on shipment details through to coordinating timelines for branded collateral and list management.
    • Keep our merch machine running by managing inventory and coordinating orders
    • Handle day-to-day marketing operations, from placing print orders to fulfilling sampling requests and shipping boxes.
    • Act as a liaison with vendors and agencies, helping to keep projects on track and communication flowing.
    • Coordinate with our Creative Director to ensure design needs and marketing orders are executed without a hitch.
    • Manage coupon setup and support retail launches by collaborating with our Sales and Customer Service teams.
    • Assist with website updates and maintenance, like homepage swaps and campaign page builds.
    • Assist with content syndication across retailer sites
    • Set up email and SMS campaigns, as needed
    • Provide occasional customer service backup when needed.
    • This role offers a front-row seat to a wide range of marketing initiatives, and we’ll support you in diving deeper into the areas that spark your interest

What You Bring to the Table

    Skills & Strengths

    • A self-starter with a can-do attitude. You’re energized by crossing things off your list and diving into whatever’s needed.
    • Stellar communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
    • Obsessed with the details - logistics, timelines, and task-tracking are your thing.
    • Willing to go the extra mile and pitch in wherever needed to make things happen.
    • Adaptable and unfazed by changing plans or moving targets.
    • Proactive in thinking ahead to what comes next to avoid last minute fire-drills.
    • Confident in owning relationships with outside partners/vendors and taking initiative by bringing recommendations to the team for sign off.

      • Experience & Education

      • 2+ years of relevant experience in marketing, ideally in CPG, brand, or events.
      • Hands-on experience planning or supporting trade shows, brand events, or demos = major plus.
      • BA required, Marketing or related field preferred.

        • Must-Haves

        • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.
        • Ability to travel occasionally for events.
        • Willingness to lift and move boxes (up to 50 lbs) as needed.
        • Some weekend and evening work required during events.

          • A Few More Things We Value

          • You’re hungry to learn and love being a team player.
          • You like pitching in wherever needed and you’re not scared of grunt work.
          • You’re passionate about snacks, storytelling, and growing a brand.
          • You bring a great attitude and energy to the team.

Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary
    • Annual performance bonus
    • Equity opportunity
    • Excellent medical/dental/vision benefits
    • 401(k)
    • 3 weeks paid vacation + 14 paid holidays
    • Paid parental leave
    • Paid time off to volunteer
    • Additional perks like wellness & tech stipends
    • Fun, entrepreneurial culture

A Bit More About Us

We’re a female-founded success story. This alone—regardless of the industry—requires true grit, mettle, and perseverance. We operate with an ethos that any idea is plausible until proven otherwise. A bold flavor combo with a totally new production method? Let’s try it. A major change to improve quality, even if it’s hard? We’ll make it happen. We lead with conviction, not hesitation. The world can be intimidating, but we stay curious, driven, and brave.

Our Mission

We craft ethical food that makes you and your body happy. We believe everyone deserves to eat the kind of nutritious, clean, delicious food we’re fortunate enough to share with our own families and friends. We work to raise up and support women and the children they care for in both our local communities and around the globe because no child should go without food or an education.

We provide secure, efficient, and tailored services to financial institutions and businesses, enabling seamless transactions for their customers. combines deep MAP product expertise, strong understanding of credit union core processing environments,

and clear, engaging storytelling. This role ensures credit unions can confidently adopt and optimize MAP

products including MAP Defense, MAP Data, card processing tools, and supporting DPS platforms by creating

and facilitating training experiences that are accurate, relevant, and easy to follow.

capabilities.
