We are committed to furthering issues like climate change, health care, and economic and racial justice from a progressive perspective, we seek to engage the public in these areas as well as others. We also recognize the urgency of confronting institutional racism and inequity within our political system and strive to make positive changes within our system as a result.

This role will report to the Distributed Organizing Director.

This is a fully remote position with no location requirement. We encourage candidates from all locations within the United States to apply.

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Remote Position: Yes

Union Position: No

Travel Requirements: Less than 10%

End Date: 11/6/26

WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE:

  • Execute a values-driven and data-informed distributed organizing program with a team that will recruit, train, and organize remote volunteers to hit voter contact and mobilization goals in key 2026races and states.
  • Run regular P2P campaigns including data requests, script and campaign drafting, QA process, campaign launch, and debrief and clean up.
  • Draft and edit training guides, memos, templates, and toolkits to support volunteers’ direct voter contact over email, phone, text, Slack, and other platforms.
  • Lead trainings or workshops and coach our volunteers before, during, or after their shifts
  • Pull regular data metrics and write regular progress qualitative and quantitative reports on the impact of direct voter contact.
  • Recruit, train, and engage a team of volunteer leaders.
  • Be a digital community manager and administrator.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

ABOUT YOU:

  • Familiarity administering and managing peer-to-peer texting campaigns on platforms such as Scale to Win Text, Hustle, ThruText (formerly Relay), Spoke, and/or others.
  • Experience in either field or digital positions on political campaigns, training volunteers, OR have managed and grown active online communities.
  • Exceptional writing, copyediting, and proofreading skills.
  • The candidate must have excellent organizational skills, and demonstrate a clear ability to adapt rapidly to evolving priorities and deadlines.
  • They must have a strong work ethic and demonstrate consistent attention to detail.
  • Able to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced team setting.
  • Demonstrate strong team working skills by fostering a supportive and motivating atmosphere.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience growing and managing digital volunteer teams.
  • Experience and comfortability with leading digital trainings and/or events
  • Proficiency with advocacy CRM tools such as NGP VAN, Mobilize, and Action Network Experience working with multiple tools within the Google Workspace.

SALARY INFORMATION:

The starting salary range for this position is $72,000 - $85,000. The final base salary will be determined by various factors, including individual qualifications and internal parity, which will be objectively assessed during the interview process.

BENEFITS:

Our comprehensive benefits package plays an essential part in how we recognize you for your critical contribution toward our organization’s mission.

Taking Care of Your Future:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance: 100% coverage for you and for your dependents
  • Short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance
  • 401(k) plan - we’ll match 100% up to 4% of your salary

Setting You Up for Success:

  • Up to $150 per month to use toward your cell phone and internet costs
  • $100 per month to use toward your personal health and wellness goals
  • Flexible spending account for dependent care
  • Professional development opportunities to help you achieve your best self

ABOUT NEXTGEN AMERICA:

NextGen America is the leading national organization for engaging young people through voter education, registration and mobilization. We invite 18-to-35 year olds — the largest and most diverse generation in American history — into our democracy to ensure our government works for them and to find new solutions to the dire challenges facing our society and the world. Since 2013, NextGen America has registered more than 1.5 million young voters and educated many millions more.

raw.description:
Job Title: Customer Success Manager

Location: Remote

Job Scope:

We are seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager to own and drive the success of our customers using

our SaaS products. This role emphasizes customer satisfaction, product adoption, feature enablement, proactive

customer health management, SLA and SOP adherence and identification of opportunities to continuously improve

the customer experience. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, commercially aware and customer-centric

professional who can build strong customer relationships, anticipate customer needs, coordinate effectively with

internal teams and identify and close paid Change Request (CR) and expansion opportunities.

Responsibilities:

  • Customer Relationship and Success Management:

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, build trusted long-term relationships, understand

customer objectives and challenges, conduct regular customer touchpoints and business reviews, own

customer success plans and proactively identify and mitigate customer risks.

• Product Adoption and Usage Monitoring:

Measure and monitor product and feature adoption, identify underutilized capabilities or declining usage,

establish adoption metrics and work with customers to increase usage and demonstrate greater business value

from the product.

  • Feature Enablement and Continuous Improvement:

Stay aligned with product releases and proactively identify new features relevant to each customer. Drive

feature enablement through release communication, demonstrations, walkthroughs and customer engagement

so customers continuously benefit from new product capabilities and improvements.

  • Customer Health and System Health Monitoring:

Maintain customer health indicators covering adoption, support trends, SLA performance, system health,

customer sentiment and engagement. Conduct periodic system health checks, identify potential risks or

recurring issues and provide proactive updates and recommendations to customers.

• SLA and Service Delivery Management:

Monitor adherence to agreed SLAs, proactively identify potential breaches or service-level concerns,

coordinate with Support and Engineering teams and ensure customers receive timely and meaningful updates

on incidents, resolution plans and expected timelines.

• SOP and Operational Governance:

Understand and maintain customer-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance processes

and agreed ways of working. Ensure agreed SOPs are executed consistently, monitor adherence, identify

deviations and coordinate updates when business processes or product capabilities change.

• Change Request and Revenue Generation:

Proactively identify paid Change Request (CR), enhancement and expansion opportunities. Work with

Product, Implementation and Commercial teams to qualify and scope opportunities, engage customers on

business value and commercial implications and actively pursue identified opportunities through proposal,

negotiation and closure.

  • Customer Feedback and Product Advocacy:

Capture structured customer feedback, pain points and enhancement requests, identify recurring themes and

collaborate with Product teams to ensure customer needs are appropriately considered in product prioritization

and roadmap discussions.

• Customer Reviews and Reporting:

Conduct regular customer success reviews and business reviews covering adoption, system health, SLA

performance, support trends, feature enablement, customer sentiment, risks and opportunities. Maintain

accurate customer success records, action plans, commitments and follow-ups.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Collaborate closely with Product, Product Support, Engineering, Implementation, Sales and Commercial

teams to deliver a seamless customer experience. Drive clear ownership, timelines and communication for

cross-functional customer activities and escalations.

• Customer Retention and Advocacy:

Proactively identify churn risks and develop mitigation plans. Monitor customer satisfaction and engagement,

build strong stakeholder relationships and identify opportunities to turn satisfied customers into product

advocates, references and expansion opportunities.

  • Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement:

Maintain comprehensive customer documentation covering configurations, processes, contacts,

dependencies, SOPs, risks and key decisions. Contribute to knowledge bases and customer collateral and

continuously improve customer success processes based on feedback, data and operational learnings.

Requirements

  • Basic Qualifications

o Strong written and verbal communication, listening and interpersonal skills

o Fluency in English (written and spoken)

o Proven customer relationship and stakeholder management skills

o Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail

o Minimum 3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, SaaS Support, Consulting or a

similar customer-facing role

o Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities

and follow-ups

o Ability to proactively identify customer risks, opportunities and areas for improvement

o Strong presentation and business communication skills

o Commercial awareness and ability to identify and pursue revenue opportunities

o Experience working with SLAs, operational processes, service reviews and customer governance

o Proficiency in using computer applications, including the Microsoft Office Suite

  • Preferred Qualifications

o Experience with SaaS products, particularly enterprise SaaS solutions

o Experience with HCM solutions, especially those integrated with SAP SuccessFactors

o Experience managing enterprise customers and senior customer stakeholders

o Familiarity with SAP SuccessFactors and related enterprise application ecosystems

o Understanding of SaaS product adoption, customer health metrics and usage analytics

o Experience working with Product, Engineering, Implementation and Support teams

o Experience identifying and managing Change Requests, enhancements or professional-services opportunities

o Familiarity with APIs and enterprise integration environments

o Experience with CRM, customer success or case-management platforms

o Experience conducting QBRs/EBRs or similar customer governance forums

Key Success Measures:

o Customer satisfaction, retention and overall customer health

o Product and feature adoption, including improvement in underutilized capabilities

o Successful enablement and adoption of relevant new product features

o SLA adherence and service-performance trends

o Execution and adherence to agreed customer SOPs and governance activities

o Completion of periodic system health checks and proactive customer communication

o Reduction in recurring customer issues and proactive identification of risks

o Number and value of qualified paid CR opportunities identified

o CR conversion and closure rate and revenue generated from customer-led opportunities

o Quality and timeliness of customer success plans, reviews and reporting

What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What’s the position?

As the Internal Audit Senior, you will support the execution of a risk-based audit plan that supports responsible growth, enhances financial integrity, and strengthens internal controls across business, technology, and finance operations. You will work cross-functionally with leaders from Finance, Operations, Technology, and Legal and Compliance to assess risks, evaluate the company’s control environment, and deliver actionable insights that support strategic objectives.

In this role, you will contribute to building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement by translating audit objectives into meaningful business enhancements, identifying improvement opportunities, and helping to ensure the company is well-positioned to scale responsibly and meet regulatory expectations. The ideal candidate will combine strong auditing fundamentals with a growing understanding of digital platforms, online transactions, and gaming operations.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of a risk-based internal audit plan aligned with the company’s strategic objectives and goals.

  • Assist in performing periodic risk assessments and evaluating the design and adequacy of the company’s risk and control framework.

  • Perform walkthroughs, control testing, and substantive procedures across finance, operations, and IT functions to evaluate internal controls over financial reporting and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to ensure internal audit efforts align with regulatory and licensing requirements across relevant jurisdictions.

  • Lead and assist with audits of key IT general controls (ITGCs), including evaluating system access, change management, and data integrity controls.

  • Leverage data analytics and technology-enabled audit techniques to evaluate automated controls, identify trends and anomalies, and assess emerging technology risks, including cloud-based systems and evolving IT environments.

  • Prepare clear and concise audit documentation and reports, summarizing findings and recommendations for improvement.

  • Partner with stakeholders to communicate audit results and support appropriate remediation efforts.

  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external auditors to streamline audit activities and knowledge sharing.

  • Remain current on industry trends, regulatory developments, and internal audit best practices.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

  • 3+ years of audit experience in internal audit, risk assurance, or public accounting roles.

  • Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or other relevant credentials are preferred but not required.

  • Experience in regulatory compliance in gaming and financial environments, digital gaming, fintech, or technology sectors desirable.

  • Strong understanding of financial reporting processes, including internal control frameworks and IT general controls (ITGCs).

  • Experience auditing or working with cloud platforms, system controls, and financial applications, with the ability to assess ITGCs and automated controls.

  • Solid foundation in internal audit practices, risk assessments, control testing, and reporting.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize risk, focus on impact, and deliver value through audit execution.

  • Ability to work effectively across time zones and occasionally travel for strategic in-person working sessions.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • Flexible vacation allowance.

  • Remote or Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, with opportunities for in-person collaboration at our various headquarter locations.

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

The Analyst Team Lead serves as the senior operational resource for the AR Analyst Payer Pod team, providing technical expertise, daily guidance, and workflow support while performing advanced accounts receivable functions. The Analyst Team Lead works under a supervisor to ensure productivity, quality, compliance, and service goals are achieved. They mentor team members, assist with complex account issues and escalations, provide ongoing coaching and training, and promote consistent adherence to company policies, procedures, and best practices. While this position does not have direct supervisory authority, it plays a critical leadership role in supporting team performance and operational success.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for Accounts Receivable processes, billing regulations, payer requirements, and claims resolution.
  • Provides day-to-day leadership, guidance, and technical support to AR Representatives to ensure quality, productivity, and service expectations are consistently met.
  • Acts as the first point of escalation for complex billing, claims, payer, and account issues that require advanced knowledge or resolution.
  • Partners with Supervisor to monitor team performance, identify workflow improvements, and support departmental initiatives.
  • Provides ongoing coaching, mentoring, and training to team members while reinforcing best practices and process consistency.
  • Assists leadership with monitoring productivity, quality metrics, policy compliance, and performance expectations.
  • Supports leadership by documenting performance observations, providing recommendations, and assisting with personnel-related matters as appropriate.
  • Leads or coordinates departmental escalation projects, ensuring timely resolution of high-priority accounts and client concerns.
  • Investigates, analyzes, and resolves complex insurance claims, including denials, appeals, underpayments, and reimbursement issues.
  • Processes and follows up on insurance claims to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.
  • Oversees denial and appeal management to maximize reimbursement and minimize revenue loss.
  • Manages assigned billing and work queues, ensuring accounts are prioritized and worked within established timelines.
  • Investigates payer responses and updates patient accounts with accurate insurance, Medicare, and billing information.
  • Exercises sound judgment when reviewing account information and making appropriate billing or account updates.
  • Maintains accurate, detailed, and compliant account documentation within company systems.
  • Identifies process improvement opportunities and provides recommendations to leadership to improve efficiency, quality, and revenue cycle performance.
  • Adapts quickly to evolving payer requirements, regulatory changes, and departmental processes.

  • May perform any additional responsibilities or special projects as required.

  • Proficiency in basic math and business calculations
  • Working knowledge of computer/data entry with the ability to learn new systems
  • Basic level of MS Office proficiency

  • Friendly, professional, and effective communications skills; able to calmly present solutions in challenging situations.
  • Proactive identification of challenges, and solution-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Service-orientation and aptitude to aptitude to resolve insurance and/or patient matters.
  • Effective analytical skills: able to use inductive and deductive reasoning to anticipate outcomes.
  • Self-directed accountability and reliability
  • Effective communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Cross-trained on all collections processes
  • Able to resolve highly escalated collections issues or concerns
  • Able to mentor and train as needed
  • Able to manage and prioritize multiple tasks/projects, work autonomously, and meet deadlines.
  • Able to work well in a team environment that promotes inclusiveness and communication among team members.
  • Communication using both verbal and written English proficiency.
  • Cultural competence

For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

We are seeking a Clinical Trial Operations Associate to join us in our mission to make brain monitoring easily accessible, interpretable, and actionable. In this role, you will collaborate with clinical research sites, project teams, and internal stakeholders to support the deployment of Beacon’s devices in clinical studies. This role focuses on study startup, site management, and live-study monitoring, ensuring the highest quality standards and compliance with regulatory requirements.
This role is fully remote anywhere in the Pacific or Mountain Timezones in the U.S. and will require up to 5% travel. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York, and Paris.

What success looks like

  • Collaborate with project teams to support study startup activities.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clinical sites, ensuring smooth operations and clear communication.
  • Provide training to research sites on the use of Beacon’s devices and study protocols, ensuring proper device usage and data collection.
  • Monitor project progress, ensuring adherence to timelines, protocols, and quality standards.
  • Maintain compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, and regulatory standards.
  • Address operational issues promptly, escalating through tools like Zendesk and Asana for resolution.
  • Provide actionable feedback from research sites to inform improvements in devices and workflows.

What you will bring

  • 2-4+ years of experience in clinical project management or clinical operations roles.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, additional languages are a bonus.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify priorities and anticipate challenges.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in data collection and reporting.
  • Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and clinical research regulatory requirements.
  • Desire to learn more about analytics, statistics, machine learning, and clinical trials.
The salary range for this role is $65,000 – $85,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.
At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

raw.excerpt: Science Buzz is a pre-launch blog that's focused on making research in the physical sciences accessible to a general audience.
raw.description:
Science Buzz is a pre-launch blog that's focused on making research in the physical sciences accessible to a general audience.

We're looking for contributors with subject matter expertise in Earth Science, Biology, Physics, Astronomy, and Chemistry (and their sub-disciplines) to produce high-quality posts on recent discoveries/research, as well as guides and outlining content for infographics.

About you:

  • You're an expert in some scientific domain. That doesn't necessarily mean you have a Ph.D. or have worked in the field professionally; we're happy to hire passionate amateurs. It does mean that you're familiar with the leading academic journals in the subject and have the background knowledge to understand the significance of new research.
    * You can write clearly about complex topics. This means you know the Jargon of the field, but can communicate what is essential without relying on it.
    * You understand the elements of producing viral content and aren't averse to formulas when they work (e.g., listicles).

Pros of working with us:

  • Get paid to learn and write about something you're genuinely interested in
    * All work published under your byline
    * Flexibility: we rarely have strict deadlines and are happy to work with people who aren't able to contribute regularly.

What we look for:

  • Typical article length of 800 - 2,000 words. We're open to longer pieces but will typically solicit them from contributors who we've worked with previously.
    * Coverage of a topic that hasn't been widely reported on other blogs or in the press.
    * We want to cover research that has been published in the last year, though this is not a hard rule.
    * Relevance: our goal is to make science engaging, the primary way to do that is by illustrating how it connects to the lives of our readers.

* A sense of humor or whimsy.

Rates: Our starting rate is $150 per published article. Ideally, we would like contributors who can write several articles per week but are open to working with talented writers who as well.

Note: Because of the volume of applications we receive, we aren't able to personally follow up with everyone, but we will be in touch within 48 hours if it seems like there's a good potential match.

If you have a specific story idea you would like to pitch: please include the working title, subject, and potential sources. While we will need to see a full draft before committing to publish a piece, you can pitch an idea get our impression of whether it's a fit for us.

Position title

Technical Lead — React & .NET

Department

Engineering & Delivery

Reports to

Head, Project Management Office / Delivery Manager

Direct reports

4–8 engineers (developers and QA), matrixed by project

Location

Remote, within India

Working hours

US shift — see Section 7 for the overlap requirement

Experience required

Minimum 5 years in React and .NET delivery, including team-leadership exposure

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

1. About PATeam Software Consulting

PATeam Software Consulting Ltd. delivers custom software product POS (ModusTech) and process-automation solutions for clients across the United States, the United Kingdom and Europe. Our delivery model is engagement-led: small, accountable teams work directly with client stakeholders from discovery through to go-live and hypercare, under a Project Management Office that holds the schedule, quality and governance line.

We are strengthening our engineering leadership bench and are looking for a Technical Lead who can own the technical outcome of a React and .NET engagement end to end inclusive of writing code, guiding a team, and standing confidently in front of the client.

2. Role Purpose

The Technical Lead is accountable for the technical quality and on-time delivery of assigned React and .NET projects. This is a hands-on leadership role: roughly half the week is spent on design, code and review, and the remainder on guiding the team, planning sprints, managing dependencies and communicating with client stakeholders.

Success in this role means predictable delivery. Commitments made at sprint planning are met, risks are raised early rather than explained late, the codebase remains maintainable as the team scales, and the client regards you as the technical authority on the engagement.

3. Key Responsibilities

3.1 Technical leadership and hands-on engineering

Own the solution architecture for assigned projects across the front end (React) and back end (.NET), including component structure, API contracts, data models, authentication and integration patterns.
Contribute production code for the most complex or highest-risk parts of the solution, and set the standard the rest of the team follows.
Run code review as a quality gate — enforce coding standards, review pull requests within agreed turnaround times, and coach through review comments rather than simply rejecting work.
Make and document technical decisions with the trade-offs stated, so that choices can be revisited later without re-litigating them from scratch.
Own non-functional quality — performance, security, accessibility, scalability and maintainability are treated as delivery requirements, not afterthoughts.
Manage technical debt deliberately by maintaining a visible register and negotiating remediation into the sprint plan.

3.2 Agile delivery and schedule control

Lead sprint planning, estimation and backlog refinement with the Product Owner and Project Manager, and hold the team to realistic, defensible commitments.
Break down requirements into stories and technical tasks with clear acceptance criteria and identified dependencies.
Protect the delivery date — track sprint burndown daily, identify slippage the day it appears, and propose concrete recovery options (scope, sequence or capacity) rather than escalating without a plan.
Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives where the Scrum Master role is not separately staffed, and act on retrospective outcomes.
Maintain accurate delivery status for PMO reporting, including RAG status, milestone confidence, risks, issues and change requests.
Manage release readiness — go-live checklists, cutover planning, rollback provisions and hypercare support arrangements.

3.3 Team leadership and development

Lead a team of 4–8 engineers across development and QA, allocating work to match capability and stretch goals.
Onboard and mentor engineers through pairing, design walkthroughs, structured feedback and clear technical direction.
Set and monitor engineering standards for branching, testing, documentation and definition of done, and hold the team to them consistently.
Conduct performance conversations and contribute to appraisals, development plans and capability assessments in partnership with the reporting manager.
Reduce single points of knowledge by insisting on documentation and deliberate cross-skilling within the team.
Support recruitment through technical screening and interview panels.

3.4 Client engagement and stakeholder management

Act as the technical point of contact for US and other international clients, translating technical positions into business language and business needs into technical requirements.
Run technical discussions and demonstrations with client architects, product owners and executive sponsors, and present options with a clear recommendation.
Manage scope conversations professionally - recognise change when it arrives, quantify its schedule and effort impact, and route it through the agreed change-control process.
Communicate proactively across time zones so that a client starting their day has the update they need without having to ask for it.
Build client confidence by being candid about risk and consistent in follow-through.

3.5 Governance, quality and process

Comply with PMO governance including project documentation, stage gates, sign-offs, time recording and audit evidence.
Own the test strategy for the engagement across unit, integration, end-to-end and UAT layers, in partnership with QA.
Maintain CI/CD discipline — automated builds, quality gates, environment management and repeatable, low-drama deployments.
Contribute to continuous improvement by feeding lessons learned and reusable assets back into organisational practice.

4. Essential Skills and Experience

Candidates must be able to evidence all of the following.

4.1 Experience

Minimum five years of professional software delivery experience with React and the .NET stack, including at least two years in a technical lead, lead developer or equivalent leadership capacity.
Demonstrable record of leading a delivery team to release on a committed schedule, ideally across multiple projects or engagements.
Hands-on experience working directly with international clients, with the United States preferred, in a consulting, outsourced or product-engineering setting.
Experience delivering within Agile frameworks (Scrum or Kanban) throughout the full lifecycle — requirements, design, build, test, release and post-go-live support.

4.2 Front-end technical skills

Strong command of React, including hooks, component composition, state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query or equivalent) and performance optimisation.
Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with modern tooling and build pipelines.
Competence in HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design, and familiarity with a component library or design system.
Front-end testing practice using Jest, React Testing Library or comparable tooling.

4.3 Back-end and platform skills

Strong command of C# and .NET (.NET 6 or later, and ASP.NET Core), including RESTful API design and layered or clean architecture patterns.
Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM, plus SQL Server or an equivalent relational database, including query performance tuning.
Practical experience with cloud services — Azure preferred, AWS acceptable — covering application hosting, identity, storage and messaging.
Version control with Git and branching strategies suited to team delivery, plus CI/CD pipeline configuration (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or equivalent).
Sound grasp of application security fundamentals, including authentication and authorisation patterns such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and JWT.

4.4 Leadership and delivery competencies

Ability to lead by influence as well as authority, and to hold a team to standards without damaging morale.
Disciplined approach to estimation, dependency management and schedule control under fixed-date pressure.
Clear written and spoken English, sufficient to hold an unscripted technical conversation with a senior client stakeholder.
Sound judgement on when to decide, when to consult and when to escalate.

4.5 Working arrangement

Willingness and availability to work United States hours on a sustained basis, including participation in client ceremonies scheduled in US time zones.
A reliable remote working setup, including stable high-speed connectivity and a quiet environment suitable for client calls.

5. Desirable Skills and Experience

Microservices, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) or event-driven architecture in production.
Exposure to process automation or RPA platforms, or to integration-heavy enterprise environments.
Certification in Azure (for example AZ-204 or AZ-305), Scrum (PSM or CSM) or SAFe.
Experience with Next.js, GraphQL, micro-frontends or mobile delivery.
Experience operating within a formal PMO governance model, including stage gates and audit requirements.
Presales or solution-estimation experience, such as contributing to proposals or technical responses.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.

6. Behavioural Expectations

We assess these as rigorously as the technical criteria.

Accountability. Owns the outcome, not just the assigned task, and does not require chasing.
Candour. Raises bad news early and factually, with options attached.
Composure. Remains measured under delivery pressure and during escalations.
Client orientation. Understands that the client is buying confidence as much as code.
Developing others. Treats the growth of the team as part of the job, not a distraction from it.

7. Working Hours and Shift Arrangement

This role supports clients in United States time zones. The expected working pattern will be set out as per specific client engagement at the point of offer.

raw.title: Director, Email & Lifecycle Marketing
raw.excerpt: About the RoleAt BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better.
raw.description:
About the Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Email is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Email & Lifecycle Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work—building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume program of 40+ campaigns per week plus automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization, and Partner Performance

  • Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
  • Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
  • Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
  • Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
  • Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

  • Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns—from planning through send and post-send analysis.
  • Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
  • Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
  • Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
  • Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets—IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops—monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
  • Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

  • Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
  • Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
  • Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys—activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back—to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
  • Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub’s own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team, and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle—including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation—and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
  • Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
  • Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
  • Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
  • Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

  • 9+ years of hands-on email, CRM, or lifecycle marketing in a high-volume program, including monetizing a newsletter or email audience through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance, and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
  • Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack—our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics—across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
  • Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
  • Strong command of segmentation, personalization, automation workflows, triggered campaigns, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives—with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—Preferred

  • Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, or media/ad-monetization company (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar).
  • Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape.
  • Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Benefits include:

  • Medical and Dental (employer pays 75% of monthly contributions)
  • Telehealth (employer paid 100%)
  • Vision insurance (employer pays 100% of monthly contributions)
  • Domestic partner coverage for all insurance plans
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan options, including employer contribution
  • Generous paid time off (PTO)
  • Generous sick time off (STO) program
  • Generous paid paternity and maternity leave policies
  • 11 holidays, including office closed the day after Thanksgiving
  • Flexible spending account program
  • Voluntary benefit programs (STD, LTD, life insurance, accident, cancer)

About BenefitHub

BenefitHub is the premier employee lifestyle benefits platform, connecting millions of employees with exclusive discounts, rewards, and perks. Our mission is to enhance the lives of employees worldwide while helping organizations attract, retain, and engage top talent through meaningful benefits.

About SAS

SAS is an accounting, technology, design, and human resources outsourcing firm dedicated to serving membership-based nonprofits, including trade associations and professional societies. We understand the unique challenges these organizations face and provide tailored solutions to streamline their operations. By partnering with SAS, organizations can focus on their mission while we handle the complexities of system selection, implementation, security, budgeting, reporting, compliance, and day-to-day tasks. Our goal is to enhance operational efficiency and financial stability, building a foundation for long-term success for our clients.

Position Summary

  • As a Senior re:Members/Impexium Analyst within the SAS Technology team, you will play a vital role in providing advanced business analysis, consultation, and project management services to our clients. Following established best practices, you will focus on evaluating, implementing, and supporting a variety of technologies, including Association Management Systems (AMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems, Website Content Management Systems (CMS), and other tools utilized by trade associations and professional societies. Experience working directly with re:Members and/or Impexium is highly desired. Candidates with implementation experience in other Association Management Systems (AMS), such as iMIS, NetForum, Nimble, or YourMembership, will also be considered. This mid-level role involves a deep understanding of business processes, technical requirements, and a commitment to driving efficiency through technology solutions.

SAS is a fully remote company – this position will be 100% remote.

Essential Functions

Collect and Document Technical and Functional Requirements

  • Gather, document, and validate technical and functional business requirements fromourclients.
  • Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and translate them into actionable system requirements.

Evaluate and Configure Business Systems

  • Assess the functions and features of various business systems supported byour clients.
  • Compare system capabilities with client needs, identifying and addressing functionality gaps.
  • Implement and configure business systems according to documented requirements.

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Conduct thorough testing of business systems against documented requirements.
  • Identify and document any deviations or deficiencies, ensuring the systems meet quality standards.

Project Management

  • Follow project plans, reporting progress regularly to stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify potential concerns or delays and communicate them to management.

Prioritization and Process Improvement

  • Collaborate with management to prioritize business and information needs.
  • Identify and define opportunities for business process improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • 4+years of experience as a Systems Analyst working in re:Members/Impexium and with a focus on business analysis and technology implementation.
  • 3+years of experience with Association Management Systems (AMS) or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems. Candidates with provenexpertiseon there:Members(formerlyImpexium) AMS will be favored.
  • Proficiency in Website Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or Drupal.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to collect, organize, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with associations, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations.
  • Familiarity with data querying languages (SQL, JSONiq) and data management/analysis tools.
  • Knowledge of project management principles or experience leading a technology project.

We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of SAS to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works.
